movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Civil: yue flute in left hand, feather plume in right. Military: shield in left hand, battleaxe in right.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Strict row-based formation (e.g., 8x8, 6x6, 4x4, 2x2) based on social rank.

music_profile.sound_description: Slow, stately, and monophonic music characterized by the resonance of stone chimes, bronze bells, and various wind instruments, organized into distinct terrace and courtyard ensembles.

basic_steps: Civil dance: Hold yue flute in left hand, feather plume in right.
Military dance: Hold shield in left hand, battleaxe in right.
Formation: Maintain strict row alignment based on rank (e.g., 8x8 for emperor).
teaching.formation: Courtyard arrangement in five directions; orchestra split into terrace (yin) and courtyard (yang) ensembles.
teaching.level_notes: Technique not described in sources beyond the holding of ritual objects and row-based formation.
teaching.rhythm: Slow, stately, monophonic; 4-8 beats per phrase.
